headline: Chainflip paused operations to investigate a possible vault exploit; it has not confirmed the $4.86 million outflow reported by Onchain Lens. CNN reported a suspected intrusion into the FBI’s national crime database, but the bureau has not publicly confirmed the scope.

incidents.what: Chainflip paused deposits, withdrawals, swaps and quotes while investigating a potential vault exploit; it has not confirmed the reported outflow or its cause.
CNN and NBC News reported that the FBI is investigating an apparent intrusion into its national crime database; the bureau had not publicly confirmed it.
CISA confirmed that attackers are exploiting a vulnerability in SAP NetWeaver.
incidents.scale: Known exploited vulnerability; victim count not disclosed

incidents.what: Universeum told guests that an attack on booking supplier Visit Group International exposed contact information.
incidents.scale: About 280,000 contact records; no payment data reported exposed

incidents.what: Staples Canada said unauthorized access at its print website exposed contact information, order summaries and encrypted passwords.
incidents.scale: Count not disclosed; no financial data reported exposed

incidents.what: Austria’s foreign ministry said intruders accessed its externally hosted website and viewed staff names and work contact details.
The agency confirmed a cyberattack on its separate property-management systems and said it had no indication that sensitive benefits-recipient data was affected.
A USDA undersecretary confirmed a cyberthreat and said no data was lost, while press reports describe suspected access to a farm-payment system.
incidents.scale: Loans and payments disrupted; access scope unconfirmed

incidents.what: Fluidkey restored wallet service on an updated app and attributed the incident to session data exposed through a logging tool.
Optimizely said it shut down a compromised legacy deployment server and removed an injected script from two sites.
incidents.scale: Two sites with script removal; data access unknown

incidents.what: Rokkatei confirmed one case of card misuse and said that personal information may also have been exposed in the earlier checkout breach.
incidents.scale: One misuse confirmed; about 8,000 card records potentially exposed

incidents.what: DeFiChain expects to reverse the effects of its November exploit and deploy a fix in December, but did not give a wallet reopening date.
incidents.scale: December target; not a reopening date
